definitions.explanation: Something that stands out from the ordinary; particularly noteworthy.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}のカレーは{格別|かくべつ}においしい。
{格別|かくべつ}のご{配慮|はいりょ}をいただき、ありがとうございます。
examples.english: Thank you for your special consideration.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}の{冷|つめ}たいビールは{格別|かくべつ}だ。
examples.english: Cold beer in summer is something special.

notes:
{格別|かくべつ} indicates something is notably different from or superior to the ordinary.

Usage patterns:
- {格別|かくべつ}に + adjective (exceptionally ~)
- {格別|かくべつ}の + noun (special ~)
- [noun]は{格別|かくべつ}だ (~ is exceptional)

Common in formal expressions:
- {格別|かくべつ}のご{高配|こうはい} (your special patronage)
- {格別|かくべつ}のお{引|ひ}き{立|た}て (your exceptional support)

Similar words:
- {特別|とくべつ} (special - more common)
- {別格|べっかく} (exceptional, in a class of its own)
